label: VERIFIED
extraction: Agent Teams AI: TypeScript orchestration framework (1,740 stars, 303 forks) supporting 200+ models across 75+ LLM providers. Kanban board as single source of truth: agents pull tasks (Backlog -> In Progress -> Review -> Done). Task ownership via lock with timestamp and agent ID. State transitions only forward; backward requires human approval or peer review rejection. Full board visibility for all agents. Structured messaging and peer review between agents. Avoids 'who does what' ambiguity and cascading failures. Framework treats coordination as first-class concern, not afterthought.
